Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 03/05/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 111 as passed the Senate allows tax land sales to occur on the premises of, or within, the courthouse or courthouse annex of the county and also allows the judge of probate to permit a designee to attend the sales on their behalf.
This bill is remedial, curative, and retroactive and will not directly affect state or local funding.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary
